purpose: Outcome-blind diagnosis through actual Fastchess clocks, changing full-game histories and persistent engines. No independent strength evidence, selection, retuning or promotion.
prerequisites: Verified frozen actors; complete short/persistent request diagnostics; passing bridge-validation-v1-a01 event/correctness/resource/overhead screen; actual JDK21 PID filename expansion and absolute log quoting verified. A one-pair smoke validates Fastchess command transport and JFR association before the full sample.
inputs: Exact prior32 SR034 development openings, not the closed unqualified confirmation. The smoke uses its first opening/color pair and is excluded from the full sample's operational statistics. Both are diagnostics only; no WDL/Elo is opened, calculated for inference, or used for future protocol decisions. Full sample is selected independent of every game outcome.
actors: Same exact native build74 core/UCI baseline and build76 BOUNDARY2 with frozen CP64 and flags3407871/ADAPTIVE16. Matched delegating Boundary2TimingMain class plus JFR/GC logging only; no algorithm, allocation, reserve, clock constant or Search policy change. Full JDK VM/modules and tool/class bytes bound before play.
method: Existing owned serial Fastchess adapter with operational reporting, strict clocks/timemargin0, no score adjudication, two200k-warmup actors per block. Per-process PID-specific JFR and GC logs retain preflight and match captures separately. Custom events provide complete request boundaries, original reported elapsed, actual owner/process CPU, command/position, nodes/termination and delivered move. Join every actual match request against PGN telemetry without exposing outcomes; include all retries and aborted Search work.
resources: 30s host admission<=2 other logical cores, memory>=8GiB/load<=75%, same post interval using all owned CPU; no other builds/tests/experiments. Fresh live actor identity preflights, native lifetime/peak memory and owned-descendant drain.90min match watchdog. Expected about30min full sample at serial W1, plus smoke/analysis; background-friendly, not CPU saturation.
interpretation: Retain and report every25ms exceedance as a clock-unqualified witness; never reclassify historical SR034 or infer superiority/inferiority. Request/JFR pause overlap and owner CPU can discriminate mechanisms but association is not historical cause. Instrumentation's measured asymmetric cost (+4.19% baseline,-0.17% candidate median) limits comparisons and precludes treating this pilot as strength confirmation.
failure: Preserve setup failure, interruptions, partial games and any integrity/resource/clock failures. No same-name overwrite or replay. Full diagnostic proceeds only after an intact smoke; any subsequent run is a separately recorded diagnostic decision, never replacement confirmation evidence.
next: Challenge actual request-level findings before deciding whether a fair prospective qualification approach is credible. Do not freeze fresh strength protocol or change production by virtue of diagnostic completion.
